centralHubGateway: Central hub · gateway to every high sector
eachGemOnA: Each gem on a node is a gate, set in the direction it sits on the sector's edge. Click a sector to inspect it. All high sectors are reached through Frontier IV.
routeNoRoutePick: ROUTENo route. Pick a sector, then Set route: the next gate is marked in gold on the minimap and in space.
abyssRulesText: Stronger aliens, bigger rewards, no safe zones. Nests attack together and stalkers hunt you. Kills fill your expedition loot: leave through a gate to bank it, lose it if destroyed. Squads earn more.
